$comment: Inert structural design schema. Lexical, UTF-8 byte, canonicalization, semantic, authority and cross-record invariants are mandatory in shared-contract-v6.json; this is not an implemented validator or an allowlist. No product parser or conformance test ran.

ArgumentName.$comment: Exact validated argument name from the entry operation truth. The leading-dollar namespace is reserved for DerivedArgument. A scan of the 13 pinned spec files found 796 distinct names, all matching this pattern, none starting with a dollar sign. It is a document observation, not a proof of reachability.

Branch.$comment: Exactly one branch condition must hold. Selection never depends on array order. The phase arrays are the execution order and reference actions of that same phase.

Condition.$comment: Closed operators: present=supplied AND non-null; absent is its exact complement; eq:null requires a supplied explicit null. Equality is typed, with no coercion. Composite arity 2..8, root depth 1, max depth 4, <=64 condition nodes total across all action and branch conditions in one profile. Single-child composites are invalid.

DerivedArgument.$comment: Coordinator-computed boolean from the sealed effective request, never a model argument. $effective_dry_run: tool dry_run OR the base global dry-run. $search_channel_nonblank: the assembled body has a string channel_id whose value is nonempty after Go strings.TrimSpace.

OperationSelector.$comment: Canonical operation_id of the bound entry, needed because one profile serves several operations whose conditions differ. Never a model argument.

PageDeclaration.$comment: Every selected declaration has positive finite page/item limits, bounded by profile and global/action limits. Zero forbids the corresponding family; it is never unlimited or not-applicable. Count returned items before aggregation/publication, with no silent truncation. A positive bound must be justified by the admitted entry/source response contract; arbitrary new endpoint count caps are not selected. The old operation-cursor items_per_page=0 is a negative witness only. Missing compatible bound makes a materialized entry/release unsupported, not source-equivalent. See action-semantics-v6.md section 5; ordinary CLI native-unpaginated roster remains a separate source witness.

Profile.$comment: Closed fixed-program semantics in action-semantics-v6.md. <=64 distinct actions total across phases; every action referenced in its own phase; <=64 total condition nodes, depth<=4; exactly one total/exclusive branch; limits intersect global/action/source bounds; zero forbids, never unlimited. All cross-record target/output/capability/page/branch correlations require semantic checks, not merely this structural schema.

RawDM.x-canonical-form: Exactly the native stored pair identity returned by common.GetFakeChannelIDWith for the two principals: two NativeID values joined by one U+0040. A bare peer UID, a space-prefixed conversation ID, a reversed pair or any locally reconstructed alias is not this domain.

Slot.$comment: A slot replaces one whole JSON value. It cannot delete a key or edit a substring. Marker object is exactly {"$octo_slot":"<id>"}. query and depth are not slots: query selects discovery_index rows and depth selects a fixed schema_variant.

Target.$comment: Targets must equal the exact per-ID candidate typed tuple/string, not merely this structural union.

TargetTemplate.$comment: parameters=operation_truth maps all sealed validated arguments through the bound entry parameter truth, so the shared leaf profile does not enumerate per-operation arguments. variables adds only helper-derived values. kind must equal Action.boundary.

VariableDestination.$comment: Header names are the declared non-credential request headers found in the 13 pinned specs, excluding X-Space-Id, which trusted context forces and a variable may never select. Each is usable only when declared by the target operation truth.

VariableSource.$comment: Finite declared views/scopes and type/availability obligations are in action-semantics-v6.md. A pointer never starts a loop.
